segments.purpose: Inspect current provider coupling, work history, handoff semantics, and observable failure patterns.
Produce one bounded provider-neutral communication and handoff capability increment with focused validation.

decisionBasis: The request requires evidence gathering, architecture revision, implementation, and validation under one objective.
There is one material contribution and one implementation owner; no multi-contribution orchestration topology is required.
Agent count, session count, transport choice, and message format are not topology signals.
reassessmentTriggers: target files gain an overlapping active writer
the change requires provider activation or live session control
the public Component contract must widen beyond communication and handoff coordination
